Year-Book of the Scientific and Learned Societies of Great Britain 
and Ireland. Third Annual Issue. London: Griffin & Co.: 
1886. 
We have already pointed out the great value of this book in 
noticing the two former issues. The present contains, in addition 
to the lists of papers read before the Societies in 1885, a note of 
the publications of the Scientific Departments connected with the 
State.
